title: Dispatch: reclassify impossible oversized-stack reviews (attempt 1)
description:
Works defect bead eshyra-eks3 (read it first: full analysis with file/line refs). Parent spec: eshyra-f0nz (acceptance criterion 2).

Branch/worktree: this bead's id, cut from eshyra-f0nz.

## Code survey (verified 2026-07-19)

- `packages/core/data/migrations/0018_inventory_adoption_review.sql`: assigns review_kind='oversized-stack' purely by legacy reason-string LIKE match; never checks current `inventory.quantity`. Immutable — do not edit.
- `packages/core/src/state/itemAdoption.ts:347-349`: `set-reviewed-quantity` (the ONLY action accepted for oversized-stack, enforced both in code at ~328-330 and by the SQL CHECK on `inventory_adoption_resolution`) is rejected when `row.quantity <= MAX_MAGIC_ITEM_ADOPTION_SINGLETONS` (=100). Result: permanent quarantine.
- `itemAdoptionReview.ts`: review kinds and kind→action mapping.
- Highest migration on this branch: 0021 → the new migration is 0022 here. NOTE FOR COMMIT MESSAGE/NOTES: branch eshyra-geny (separate in-flight PR) also adds a 0022; the supervisor renumbers whichever PR merges second. Do not try to coordinate this yourself.

## Required behavior change

New migration `0022_adoption_review_oversized_reclassification.sql`:

- For every `inventory_adoption_review` row with `review_kind='oversized-stack'` whose joined `inventory.quantity <= 100`, set `review_kind='malformed-evidence'` (whose `discard-evidence` resolution is valid per the existing CHECK pairing) and prepend/append a bracketed reclassification note to `reason` (reason CHECK only requires non-empty; preserve the original reason text within it).
- Leave `raw_properties_json` / `raw_item_state_json` untouched (evidence preservation).
- Genuine oversized rows (quantity > 100) and all other review kinds untouched.
- Consider a review row whose inventory row no longer exists (ON DELETE CASCADE makes this unlikely; verify) — handle via the join semantics, do not crash.

No changes to `itemAdoption.ts` resolution logic: post-migration the impossible state cannot recur because quarantine blocks all quantity-affecting item mutations; the existing fail-closed rejection stays as the guard. If you find a live path that can still reduce a quarantined row's quantity below 101, file a follow-up bead with `bd create` rather than expanding scope.

## Tests

Follow the existing migration-test pattern (see how earlier data migrations are tested, e.g. around 0018): seed a pre-0022 database with (a) an oversized-stack review row whose inventory quantity is 40, (b) one whose quantity is 150, (c) a malformed-evidence row. After migrations: (a) is malformed-evidence with augmented reason and can be resolved via discard-evidence + adopted (end-to-end through `adoptMagicItem`/the resolution path); (b) is still oversized-stack and resolvable via set-reviewed-quantity; (c) unchanged.

## Verification

`npm ci` first, then `npm run verify:worktree` from this worktree. Commit on this branch only.
